text: The F.G. Gardiner Expressway Strategic Rehabilitation Plan was developed by the City of Toronto in 2014 and sets the framework for lifecycle renewal of the expressway from Highway 427 to the Don Valley Parkway (DVP). Section 1 of the Rehabilitation Project was recently completed from Jarvis Street to Cherry Street, and the City is now proceeding with Section 2 of the Rehabilitation Plan from Dufferin Street to Strachan Avenue. The project includes replacement of the superstructure (girders and deck) and rehabilitation of the substructure (bents). Construction is expected to commence in Q4 2023 and be completed in 2026. Parsons Inc. (Parsons) is the City of Toronto’s Owner’s Engineer and Technical Advisor (OE/TA) for this section of the Rehabilitation Plan and has prepared a Reference Concept Design (RCD) for the rehabilitation project.
